media.alt: Text-led reel on a handwriting practice sheet (cream paper, ruled rows, a rust margin line), with the K&A Performance logo and ka-performancefl.com at the top of every frame. Hook: Show it, then let them try it. Three ruled rows: 1 Watch one done, in solid ink; 2 Do one with hints, in gray letters to trace; 3 Do one alone, in teal. Real screens from our sample course, The RFI that gets answered. Step 1, Watch one done: a finished example, and why each part is there, over screen 5, the four parts of a finished request (Question, References, Impact and date, Proposal) with the question Please confirm the required slab thickness and reinforcing beneath the loading dock pit. Step 2, Do one with hints: then they build one, with the pieces and labels in front of them, over screen 7, a fragment picked up and two of four labeled fields filled. Step 3, Do one alone: then a new problem, no pieces, no labels, over screen 8, a duct that does not fit above a corridor ceiling and an empty box, Draft one answerable question. Ends on a quote from our training page, A single topic taught properly: objectives, teaching, practice, check. Six original courses. Open them and try the work. ka-performancefl.com/training. Call Alex 904-210-1071.
